name: OpenChamber
description: OpenChamber is a rich desktop, web, and mobile UI for the OpenCode AI agent with a chat timeline, diff viewer, integrated terminal, Git workflows, file browser, multi-agent runs, voice mode, and PR creation.

notes.text: Access OpenChamber in your browser at http://<container-ip>. The UI password is auto-generated and stored in /opt/openchamber/.env (OPENCHAMBER_UI_PASSWORD).
Bundles OpenCode server on port 4095 as a backend. OpenCode password is stored in /opt/opencode/.env (OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD).
Config and session data is stored in /root/.config/openchamber/ and /root/.config/opencode/.
